text:
alexandra: Hey @help — new hire here. Quick Q about secrets: I got Vault + KMS access but I can't see secrets under secret/data/apps/billing. Where do I formally request DB creds for the billing-worker app?

maya: welcome! :wave: For DB creds we use the infra ticket flow. If you need immediate read-only access, open infra-ops:access with env=prod app=billing-worker role=read and include a justification + TTL. If it's KMS-wrapped key access you'll also need security approval.

alexandra: thanks — I'm onboarding this week and just want read-only so I can run integration tests. I added myself to the vault-access group but still can't list the path.

ops-bot: Notice: Your Vault token expires in 23 days. If you need faster access, file infra-ops:access with 'env=prod app=billing-worker role=read'. For help, run `help request-vault` or see /confluence/security/how-to-request-secrets.

samir: @alexandra you probably need the app-owners' sign-off too. Ping @jess (billing oncall) in your ticket and include the exact secret path and reason. Keep the justification short like: "onboarding - run integration tests, read-only, expires 7d".

jess: Posted — happy to approve once the ticket exists. Quick checklist: 1) open infra-ops:access 2) add `env`, `app`, `role`, `reason` 3) set `ttl` (default 7d for onboarding). I'll watch for the ticket.

alexandra: one more: who signs off for KMS key unwrap permissions? I might need to decrypt some test payloads that are KMS-wrapped.

security-bot: Sec policy summary: KMS key access requires two approvers (app owner + sec lead) and an audit comment. See https://confluence.redwood/security/kms-ops for the exact checklist and allowed TTLs.

maya: rotation basics: general creds rotate every 90 days by default, but tickets can request shorter TTLs (e.g., `ttl=7d`). For service accounts we strongly prefer minting short-lived creds via the vault-mint service instead of long-lived static keys.

alexandra: can someone paste the CLI snippet I should include in the ticket for a one-week onboarding secret?

samir: Use this as a sample (put in the ticket body):
```
# request a temp secret for billing-worker, 7d TTL
vault write auth/approle/role/billing-worker/secret-id ttl=168h
# or request via infra-api:
curl -X POST https://infra.redwood/api/requests \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ME' \
  -d '{"env":"prod","app":"billing-worker","role":"read","ttl":"7d","reason":"onboarding - alexandra"}'
```
Include `approvers=@jess @security` in the ticket.

jess: also CC security@redwood for any KMS unwrap requests. If it's just KV read access, security usually approves quickly after I confirm.

maya: if `vault` CLI errors with permission denied, run `scripts/gimme-vault-access.sh` from infra-tools and paste the error output here. We can triage.

alexandra: Opening the ticket now — infra-ops:access — title: "Onboard: billing-worker read for alexandra" — will include the snippet + approvers. Thanks y'all :raised_hands:

ops-bot: Ticket created: #INC-4532 by alexandra. Assigned to infra-ops. Estimated manual approval ~ 4 business hours.

alexandra: got it — pinging @jess and @security. Appreciate the help!
